name: crash-course-builder
description: A local-first AI crash course builder.

scripts.dev: npm run build:contracts && concurrently -k -n contracts,server,web -c gray,blue,green "npm:dev:contracts" "npm:dev:server" "npm:dev:web"
scripts.build: npm run build:contracts && npm run build:app
scripts.build:app: npm run build -w @ccb/web && npm run build -w @ccb/server
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:contracts && npm run typecheck:workspaces
scripts.typecheck:workspaces: concurrently --kill-others-on-fail -n contracts,server,web,e2e -c gray,blue,green,magenta "npm run typecheck -w @ccb/contracts" "npm run typecheck -w @ccb/server" "npm run typecheck -w @ccb/web" "tsc -p e2e/tsconfig.json"
scripts.test: npm run build:contracts && npm run test:workspaces
scripts.test:workspaces: concurrently --kill-others-on-fail -n contracts,server,web -c gray,blue,green "npm run test -w @ccb/contracts" "npm run test -w @ccb/server" "npm run test -w @ccb/web"
scripts.test:coverage: npm run build:contracts && npm run test:coverage:workspaces
scripts.test:coverage:workspaces: concurrently --kill-others-on-fail -n contracts,server,web -c gray,blue,green "npm run test:coverage -w @ccb/contracts" "npm run test:coverage -w @ccb/server" "npm run test:coverage -w @ccb/web"
scripts.validate:contracts: npm run build:contracts && npm run test -w @ccb/contracts
scripts.verify: npm run build:contracts && npm run format:check && npm run lint && npm run typecheck:workspaces && npm run test:coverage:workspaces && npm run build:app && npm run check:size
scripts.verify:fast: npm run build:contracts && npm run format:check && npm run lint && npm run typecheck:workspaces && npm run test:workspaces
scripts.clean: rimraf apps/server/dist apps/web/dist apps/web/.angular packages/contracts/dist coverage playwright-report test-results .tmp
